title: Update 2021/9/22: Evaluating and Training the Models
summary: CuBERT is a family of BERT-style models pre-trained on deduplicated Python and Java source corpora drawn from public GitHub, released with vocabularies, fine-tuned checkpoints and a run_classifier.py harness for code classification tasks such as exception-type prediction. Meridian is evaluating it as the encoder behind internal code-quality and review-triage features.
